opening.argument: The video promises free Robux, including an “infinite amount” and one million, then directs viewers to enter a username and earn through surveys, app installs, and referrals. The speaker says free Robux follows when others use a referral link and sign up, while the displayed survey entries show reward buttons. These are low-barrier offers of Robux tied to account information, completing offers, and recruiting sign-ups. A separate giveaway asks for subscriptions, likes, notifications, and a username comment as audience engagement; it does not change what the generator promotes. The records do not verify that any payout occurs, that the site operates, or what information the offers require. Those limits matter, but the video’s central pitch remains free or potentially unlimited Robux in exchange for these steps.
